<b>My Missing Courier</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired from [[Bellhart|Bellhart's]] [[Wishwall]] after defeating [[Widow]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall in Bellhart
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must find [[Tipp]]'s location within the north part of [[Bone Bottom]]. Parts of Tipp's cargo are scattered around [[Shellwood]], which can be interacted with to track his pathway.

At this location, Tipp is hiding from two [[Caranid]]s, who have to be defeated to save him and return him to Bellhart.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp My Missing Courier.png!Tipp's location in Bone Bottom
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Tipp in Bone Bottom
}}

== Reward ==
After completing the Wish, [[Frey]] expands her shop inventory with the [[Multibinder]], a [[Spool Fragment]], and [[Shard Bundle]]s. Completing this Wish is also a prerequisite to unlock the <i>[[My Missing Brother]]</i> Wish.
